stemMd: An ideal 9 V battery is connected to an 18 ohm resistor. What current flows?
explanationMd: Ohm's law gives I=V/R=9/18=0.5 A. Ideal battery means no additional internal-resistance voltage drop is included.

distractorRationale.e: This reverses voltage divided by resistance.
